shots.detail_en: MANCANG paces back and forth outside CH's building in a delivery raincoat, a fat envelope tucked inside his jacket.
shots.sub: 就当……给兄弟情补个仓。
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH opens the door; MANCANG stuffs the envelope into his hands and wheels around to flee.
shots.sub: 别问！送外卖攒的！风大，你拿着！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: The envelope flops open: crumpled small bills and a handwritten note reading 'help the boss win'.
CH grabs MANCANG's arm and presses the money firmly back into his raincoat pocket.
shots.sub: 你的钱，只能进你自己的账。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH gently straightens MANCANG's rain-hat, knocked crooked by the downpour.
shots.sub: 这一仗的本金我自己背。风险自担——你的也一样。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: MANCANG's eyes go crimson, rain dripping off his chin, lips trembling.
shots.sub: 老大……我全仓的心还在啊！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH turns away to fix his own collar, voice dropped soft.
shots.sub: 心比钱重。留着它——等仗打完，回来陪我喝满仓酒。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: MANCANG unclips his pager from his belt, slaps it into CH's palm, and dives headfirst into the rain.
shots.sub: 帮我保管！从今晚起，我戒行情了！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: Deep night, heavier rain: RED waits in the stairwell with a kraft-paper archive bag, umbrella tilted, eyes red from three sleepless nights.
shots.sub: 等我很久了吧。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: RED sets the archive bag on the desk, fingers pressing the flap shut for a long moment before letting go.
shots.sub: 这是它的全部账——最后三页，你自己看。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: The pages slide out: a hand-copied fictional ledger, the paper yellowing toward the end.
shots.sub: 我盯了三个通宵。这局最深那笔钱——老得不像话。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH turns to the third-to-last page and his fingertip suddenly stops — only the stopped hand is shown, never the page.
shots.sub: 味道对上了。就是……十年前那口井。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: RED steps to his shoulder and the two read the same lamplit page side by side.
shots.sub: 我不问你要做什么。我只要你知道——账，不会骗人。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH glances at her, then slides the desk lamp a little toward her side.
shots.sub: 红利，你是这盘上最亮的那只眼睛。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Three-line montage: MANCANG pedaling deliveries through rain / RED ticking the last ledger page / XIONGWEI's machine room lit all night.
shots.sub: 决战前夜——三路人，都没睡。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: In the penthouse XIONG stands at the rain-streaked floor window with XIONGWEI behind him.
shots.sub: 让市场收账——它从不迟到。明天开市，放他到井底来。不用放。明天——他自己会走到我们门口。
shots.speaker: 熊天成／熊伟

shots.detail_en: CH clears the desk and lays down the first object with both hands: his father's notebook.
shots.sub: 爸的眼睛——看路。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Second on the desk: RED's ledger pages, edges still damp with rain.
shots.sub: 红利的眼睛——看账。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Third on the desk: MANCANG's pager, its screen giving off a faint green glow in the dark.
shots.sub: 满仓的眼睛——看人。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Overhead shot: the three objects lie in a row under the lamp like three open eyes, CH's slow-one-minute pocket watch set at the center.
shots.sub: 三只眼睛，看同一个局。怀表慢的那一分钟——明天，补上。
shots.speaker: 旁白／长虹

shots.detail_en: Black screen with the next-episode teaser card in white text.
shots.sub: 最后一块拼图——在熊伟的机房里。
shots.speaker: 字幕
shots.card: 最后一块拼图——在熊伟的机房里。
